horizontal.escena:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE independent full-bleed narrative or symbolic PHYSICAL PAPER-CUT artwork, never a three-panel collage. All reference images are OUR OWN AI-generated visual-bible sheets. Use their identities, shapes and material language, not their multiple-view layouts, cropped auxiliary portraits or white specimen insets. Very expressive handcrafted thick matte dyed cardstock: clear pale cut cross-sections, lifted and curled edges, separated shadows between actual layers, deliberate hand-cut curves, folded leaf midribs, cut and folded feather vanes, visibly woven paper fibres, water as overlapping blue sheets and ripples. Heads and faces use few QUIET paper planes with natural proportions; no polygon-faceted CGI cheekbones, shiny skin, plastic dolls or digital-paint substitutes. Whole principal bodies, feet, wings, snouts, tails and ornament tips remain inside frame. The environmental world continues outside all four edges; no visible plinth, frame, diorama perimeter, tabletop, collage, model-sheet layout or printed text. Material depth comes between world layers. Colors differentiate each actor and each narrative rather than cloning the same hunter. Preserve proper reference clothes: bark/fibre covers and sparse seeds, feathers and small quill ornaments where present, no modern shirts, trousers, ponchos or synthetic beads. When a character has a pale nasal quill in the reference, make its near tip plainly visible at the nostril base against skin. No real-person likeness, private-photo reuse, medical or ritual instructions. This is original editorial art of the frozen adaptation, not a certified traditional motif.

MYTH: Yarokamena, el árbol y el gusano formidable. FORMAT: horizontal 16:9, preferably 1536 x 864. FUNCTION: ENTRADA: expansive environmental situation opening the myth; figures small within the world, not a giant portrait.
Reference 1: L11 — Yarokamena · árbol formidable. 
Reference 2: P36 — Yarokaigïro · gusano formidable. 
Reference 3: L05 — Monte · sendero y dosel. 

PRIMARY SCENE / OPERATION:
Wide thunder-dark Amazonian forest clearing, ONE enormous living tree Yarokamena matching L11 and ONE formidable thick worm P36 coiled at its base. The entire worm head and tapered tail are within frame, no spikes or dragon horns. Around the tree roots, abundant fallen fruits transition into dense charcoal growth shadows, one visible relation of abundance turning threatening. No swallowed humans, trophies, gore or extra monsters. Tiny naturally scaled forest at the edges conveys the extraordinary tree. Paper bark peels, stacked root pieces and scarlet/ochre worm accents are tactile; the world full bleed, not an isolated specimen on a base.

VISIBLE CHECK: Un árbol y gusano enteros; frutos y raíces muestran abundancia y amenaza.

vertical.escena:
Use case: image editing. Edit OUR OWN AI-GENERATED paper-cut original, reference image 1. Make one independent full-bleed artwork in vertical 9:16, preferably 864 x 1536.

CORRECTION:
Pull the camera BACK about 35 percent and recenter the group. Keep the ENTIRE SINGLE giant worm, all its connected segmented body including its right side bend, head, antennae and tail, safely inside the vertical canvas. Both whole brothers, all their feet and the full raised macana and lightning form must fit inside with generous air at both borders. Preserve the poised confrontation before impact, identities, nasal quills, costumes, storm and layered forest. No added people, no extra worm and no injury.

Preserve expressive physical matte cardstock, actual separated layer shadows, pale cut cross-sections, hand-cut curves, folded feather vanes and leaf midribs. Quiet natural paper-plane faces, no CGI, plastic or digital painting. The environment continues beyond all four borders; no frame, plinth or specimen-sheet layout. No printed text. Every principal whole body, head, hand, foot, wing and ornament tip must remain inside the canvas. Retain the original color relationships and traditional fibre covers. These are original editorial illustrations, not certified traditional symbols. No private photo, real-person likeness or ritual instructions.

MYTH: Yarokamena, el árbol y el gusano formidable. FORMAT: square 1:1, 1024 x 1024. FUNCTION: HUELLA: ONE primary motif plus ONE impossible symbolic operation, readable at thumbnail; not a third literal scene, parade of props or empty landscape.
Reference 1: P36 — Yarokaigïro · gusano formidable. 
Reference 2: A16 — Danta · cabeza del gusano. 
Reference 3: A17 — Vaca marina · cola del gusano. 

PRIMARY SCENE / OPERATION:
ONE long formidable WORM SILHOUETTE made of thick charcoal and ochre paper opens along a clean central seam. Its same separated LEFT piece curves into a whole tapir shape and its RIGHT piece into a whole manatee shape, each still visibly part of the original carrier. One original editorial symbolic operation visualizes the narrative transformation into water/forest animals. No gore, meat, blood, skeleton, battle, lightning bolt or humans. Complete two animal endpoints inside; forest-green paper on one side and river-blue on the other continue full bleed. One metamorphic ribbon, not three independent specimen panels.

VISIBLE CHECK: Una silueta de gusano se abre en danta y vaca marina, sin restos sangrientos.
